prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the mold from workbench and move it to tray.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether a clean mold is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A white robot arm (jointed segments, black cable running along it) stands at upper centre on a light bench top, mounted to a white plate with hex bolts.

In front of its base, on an aluminium extrusion rail, sits a small squeeze bottle standing upright, its body filled with dark teal/blue-green liquid, topped by a light blue nozzle cap that appears closed. Beside it to the right lies a white plate bearing a black-and-white ArUco-style fiducial marker labelled "620".

At lower right, close to the camera, is a larger white plastic bottle upright with a bright red cap/nozzle attached; its contents are not visible. Behind, a dark grey floor and a white perforated tray at upper left.
observations: The description mentions a robot arm, a squeeze bottle, a fiducial marker, and a large white bottle, but does not describe the presence of a mold on the workbench.
